On October 10, 2025, the vivo Developer Conference (VDC) took place in Shenzhen, where the highly anticipated OriginOS 6 system was officially unveiled, drawing widespread attention both inside and outside the venue. However, in the view of Leifeng.com, the true hidden star of this VDC was the 2025 Blue Heart Intelligent Strategy, as the content of this strategic upgrade directly impacts the personal experience of every user.

Data shows that 78% of enterprises use AI in their operations, and 71% rely on generative AI for marketing, operations, and product development. When it comes to the practicality of AI, most people would likely answer affirmatively.

items.title: 从“产能扩张”到“架构升级”，AI存储打响「升维战」

excerpt_i18n.en:
Author: Yang Yiting | Editor: Bao Yonggang
As the global tech industry accelerates into the AI era, the storage sector is undergoing a profound paradigm shift. The once cyclical market is now dominated by strong, sustained structural growth, a consensus highlighted at the recent GMIF 2025 Innovation Summit.

Historically, the storage market has experienced cyclical fluctuations: prices plummet during oversupply and rebound briefly with rising demand. Driven by AI needs, the industry is entering a phase of continuous high growth.

Market forecasts indicate the new storage market will reach nearly $200 billion by 2025, a 17% year-on-year increase, and is expected to expand to approximately $230 billion by 2027.

At the summit, Han Xiaomin, General Manager of Aijiwei Consulting, analyzed that the current recovery in storage is fueled not by smartphones and PCs but by AI-driven computing demands. He noted that while North American internet giants lead this growth with massive investments, China, ranking second globally in AI, faces constraints due to limited advanced chip supply.

However, recent increases in cloud infrastructure investment plans by major Chinese internet firms like Alibaba and ByteDance suggest actual market growth may exceed the 17% forecast, potentially reaching around 22%.
excerpt_i18n.es: Autor|Yang Yiting Editor|Bao Yonggang. Mientras la industria tecnológica global acelera hacia la era de la IA, el sector del almacenamiento está experimentando un profundo cambio de paradigma. Un mercado antes marcado por fluctuaciones cíclicas evidentes está siendo impulsado por una fuerza de crecimiento estructural sólida y sostenida. Este cambio fue un consenso en la reciente Cumbre de Innovación GMIF 2025. Durante mucho tiempo, el mercado de almacenamiento ha mostrado oscilaciones cíclicas: los precios se desploman con el exceso de capacidad y repuntan brevemente con la recuperación de la demanda. Impulsado por la demanda de IA, el sector se adentra en una fase de alto crecimiento continuo. Las proyecciones indican que el mercado de almacenamiento emergente alcanzará casi 200 mil millones de dólares en 2025, con un crecimiento interanual de aproximadamente un 1%.
